text: The City Clerk's Office has received notice that Randy Yuen has resigned from the Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal effective July 26, 2023. Staff from the Public Appointments Secretariat in the City Clerk's Office are working on a process to recruit applicants and help bring a nominated candidate to City Council for their consideration in the coming months.
The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: 1. Received the letter (September 7, 2023) from the Manager, Public Appointments Secretariat on behalf of the City Clerk.
